# Compile requires exactly one scope

Invoking the compile command must fail unless exactly one of --full or --pr <number> is provided (they are mutually exclusive and one is required).

Prevent ambiguous or unintended compile runs by making the scope explicit and enforcing the pipeline's expected input mode.

**Anchored to:**
